pending.body: Strengthen `probe_thermal_suppression` so the cool control must itself reproduce. In `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs:572-576`, the test falls back to `warm_readiness <= cool_readiness` whenever both arms finish with zero juveniles, and the only control-arm check in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs:611-624` covers health, not breeding. A regression that suppresses spawning or hatching in both tanks can still pass as long as the warm arm is slightly worse and drops one clutch. Add a positive-control assertion on the cool arm (juveniles, hatch events, berried cycles, or a minimum readiness floor) so this probe actually verifies thermal suppression relative to a working breeding baseline.

Make the summary run emit structured traces on successful executions instead of keeping them in memory only. `enable_probe_instrumentation()` attaches `SimTracer::new(Verbosity::Trace)` with no sink in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_shrimp_scenario_probes.rs:103-107`, and `HarnessRun::finish()` returns immediately for successful non-verbose runs in `crates/tank_harness/src/lib.rs:649-656`. In practice `all_shrimp_probes_summary` prints the population summary but does not log any trace output unless callers remember `TANK_E2E_VERBOSE=1`. Persist a JSONL sink or write the trace bundle from the summary path unconditionally.
